description: ADR 0051: a project repository token sealed by Back Office (HPKE base mode, DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256, AES-256-GCM, info 'back-office credentials v1') that every runner-controller implementation must open. Keys are base64 of the raw 32-byte X25519 keys; the associated data is jobId|ref|expiresAt.
